meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 把技术内容拆成“谁（who）、什么（what）、哪里（where）、为什么（why）、何时（when）”五个角度，用大白话逐条解释。
howto.when: 当你想把某个技术概念弄明白，要求用“谁、什么、哪里、为什么、何时”的方式讲人话时触发。

say.text: 这术语太技术了，用谁、什么、哪里、为什么、何时给我讲明白。
say.note: 会得到按五要素展开的通俗解释。

say.text: 用大白话拆解一下这个系统的工作原理，按那五个问题来。

howto.what_en: Breakdown technical content into five angles: who, what, where, why, when, explained in plain language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a plain-English explanation of something technical, especially via the five Ws (who, what, where, why, when).

say_en.text: This term is too technical. Explain it to me with who, what, where, why, when.
say_en.note: You'll get a plain breakdown by the five Ws.

say_en.text: Break down how this system works in plain English, using the five questions.
